review_context: The legal intake budget UI displayed validation, Rust boundary, Rust manifest, and synthetic QA run leaf reports, but did not display the recipe-level proof that those leaves were produced in the governed order.
finding_title: Leaf QA reports can be overtrusted when recipe-level proof is hidden from the UI.
finding_summary: A reviewer needs the wrapper recipe proof, not just individual passing artifacts, to know validation, scratch fixture promotion, Rust checks, final synthetic QA, and checked fixture promotion happened in the intended sequence.
observable_context: The backend already modeled UIDemoQARecipeReport with strict validators.
The frontend imported and rendered the validation suite, Rust fixture boundary, Rust fixture manifest, and synthetic QA review run reports.
The frontend did not have a checked demo UI recipe fixture, TypeScript type, assertion, or panel.
The fix adds a candidate-only checked recipe fixture and renders the recipe-level proof directly in the UI.
observable_decision_logic: Passing leaf artifacts do not prove their sequencing or freshness.

The wrapper recipe proof is the right display surface for exact validation order, clean worktree, scratch Rust evidence, final QA run, final bundle status, POC triage status, and checked fixture promotion.
The UI should display the recipe proof as local candidate evidence only and keep Lake writes, budget submission, matter opening, calibration, and silent learning blocked.
solution_path: Add demo-ui-demo-qa-recipe-report.json as checked local UI evidence.
Add UIDemoQARecipeReport and UIDemoQARecipeStep TypeScript types.
Add assertUIDemoQARecipeReport to the frontend data contract.
Render UIDemoQARecipePanel in the read-only app.
Add Python tests binding the fixture, UI strings, TypeScript assertion, and backend Pydantic model.
applies_when: A UI displays multiple QA proof artifacts produced by a governed wrapper command.
Passing Rust, validation, or synthetic QA leaf reports are not enough to prove ordering.
Checked fixtures are promoted from generated local run roots.
does_not_apply_when: A single immutable build provenance artifact already binds all leaf reports, hashes, ordering, and promotion status.
The UI is explicitly an exploratory debug view and not a review or confidence surface.
The workflow has no ordering dependency between QA artifacts.
danger_if_misapplied: If the recipe panel is treated as production readiness, reviewers may overtrust synthetic QA. It should only prove local candidate fixture sequencing and blocked authority boundaries.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify hidden recipe proof as a UI evidence gap distinct from failed tests.
Other repos with generated demo fixtures should expose wrapper provenance beside leaf QA reports.
Exception Lake design should retain sequence-proof defects separately from semantic output defects.
reviewer_notes: This record contains synthetic fixture and local artifact references only.
It records observable evidence, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not let UI recipe proof authorize budget submission, matter opening, Lake writes, or calibration.
Do not accept independently refreshed leaf reports as proof that the wrapper recipe ran.
Keep the recipe proof candidate-only until a platform owner defines canonical provenance.
